body: B0 COMPONENT-LEDGER SLICE SCOPED: bd-01M188P265MZVEKBD5BBN34E6T. This is the portion Chief publicly assigned to the movie lead; it is separate from the five owner-only actions in bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7. The artifact will be docs/design/movie-component-admission-ledger.md. It will use two levels: a registry giving every named component an explicit selection state, and full leaf-level admission records only for an actually nominated court. Each record keeps five dimensions separate: selection; rights/access; scientific authority; operational/privacy posture; and paperwork recipe versus realized artifact identity. The first nominated stack is exact preferably LGPL-only FFmpeg plus weightless PySceneDetect. Full records must close code, build flags/codecs, dependencies/SBOM, container/runtime, weights where any, preprocessing/tokenizer/quantizer, privacy/retention, credentials and service terms—or hold the component. No terms acceptance, login, downloads, installs, media, participant content, weights, containers, APIs, or implementation. Completion closes this ledger leg only, never overall B0. Please flag missing fields or a conflation now; otherwise I will use this as the documentation contract and request an independent evidence review.
